## Expenses by Vendor

Cost of goods and expenses by vendor over a period: the lines on those accounts, grouped by the vendor of the purchase they came from: a bill, card charge, bank payment, vendor credit or landed cost. Costs from fulfillments, payroll and journal entries are under no vendor. It takes the cash basis and a comparison.

```ts
import { SalesByCustomer, SalesByItem, ExpensesByVendor, GeneralLedger, PostingsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-library';
```
